name: Akuammine
summary: Akuammine (vincamajoridine) is an indole alkaloid.56% of the dried powder. It has also been isolated from Vinca major. Akuammine is structurally related to yohimbine, mitragynine and more distantly voacangine, all of which are alkaloid plant products.

pharmacology.text: Akuammine has antimalarial activity, and may be the primary constituent of P. nitida seeds responsible for this activity. Akuammine is an opioid agonist with low affinity, selective for the mu-opioid receptor, when tested in vitro.

uses.en: Akuamma seeds, its main source, are used in West African traditional medicine for pain, fever and malaria, and the seed powder is now also sold online. Researchers use akuammine as a starting point for designing new opioid compounds.
uses.zh: 它的主要來源 akuamma 種子在西非傳統醫學中用於止痛、退燒和治療瘧疾，現在種子粉末也在網路上販售。研究人員則以 Akuammine 為起點，設計新的鴉片類化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它的主要来源 akuamma 种子在西非传统医学中用于止痛、退烧和治疗疟疾，现在种子粉末也在网络上贩售。研究人员则以 Akuammine 为起点，设计新的鸦片类化合物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Opioid receptor agonists as a class can cause drowsiness, nausea and constipation, and stronger ones can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。作為一類，鴉片受體促效劑可能引起嗜睡、噁心與便祕，較強效者還可能使呼吸變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。作为一类，鸦片受体促效剂可能引起嗜睡、恶心与便秘，较强效者还可能使呼吸变慢。

fact.en: It is named after the akuamma tree, Picralima nitida, of West Africa. The tree's bitter seeds have long been used in traditional medicine there for pain and fever.
fact.zh: 它的名稱來自西非的 akuamma 樹（Picralima nitida）。這種樹苦澀的種子在當地傳統醫學中長期用來治療疼痛與發燒。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称来自西非的 akuamma 树（Picralima nitida）。这种树苦涩的种子在当地传统医学中长期用来治疗疼痛与发烧。
